name: Predatory mites
description: The web's top predators: fast-running mesostigmatic mites that eat every kind of nematode, other mites (including nematode-feeding mites and oribatids) and springtails. Functional group aggregating the predaceous mite species, measured together by the source. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
